messages:
sasha: Quick sync — want to run a micro-experiment for DP recruitment: 10 targeted partners, 2-week commitment, $500 stipend each. Goal is to validate "day-zero" commitment & earliest feedback cadence. Who's in?

leo: I'm in. Quick proposed success metrics: 1) >=70% first-week activation (at least 1 meaningful run), 2) 3 actionable product asks across partners, 3) feedback NPS >= 7.

nina: +1. Screening idea: prefer customers with 1) production inference use, 2) existing Redwood integration or willing to run a pilot branch. Proposed schedule: outreach Mon, onboard Wed, feedback checkpoints day 3 & day 10.

arjun: I can add lightweight observability hooks. Need to know which routes to tag. Suggest: `route:generate`, `route:embed`, and `route:burst-test`. I’ll add `experiment_id=dp_micro_v1` to events.

emily: Legal: we'll need the short DP NDA + stipend clause. I can share a one-page template. Who owns sending it?

sasha: Emily pls send NDA template. Nina own outreach copy. Leo owns success metrics dashboard (spreadsheet + chart). Arjun own tagging + quick telemetry dashboard. I'll coordinate partner selection.

dp-bot: Calendar event created: "DP micro-experiment kickoff — sasha" on 3500001300 (invitees: sasha, leo, nina, arjun, emily). :calendar:

leo: Draft onboarding email (short):
```
Subject: Quick 2-week design pilot with Redwood (compensated)
Hi <name>,
We'd love 2 weeks of your team's time to try a targeted flow and give quick feedback. We'll cover $500. Onboard Wed, checkpoint Thurs, final sync week 2. Interested?
Thanks, Leo
```

nina: Screening questions (short):
```
1) How many inference requests/month? (ballpark)
2) Which SDKs/paths do you use? (api/sync/embed)
3) Who would be the main contact for a 2-week trial?
```
Tagging: please add `recruit:micro_v1` label when you add to the sheet.

arjun: I'll add a short trace schema today and a dashboard link: `/dash/exp/dp_micro_v1` (will post once ready). Also adding a small smoke script we can ask partners to run: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @sample.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\"`

emily: NDA uploaded to Drive: https://redwood.company/drive/dp-nda-micro (permissions: product team). I can send via DocuSign if partner wants.

sasha: Nice. Quick checklist:
- shortlist 15 -> invite 10 (sasha)
- outreach copy (nina)
- NDA (emily)
- onboard script + smoke test (arjun)
- success sheet + charts (leo)
Please update the shared sheet: https://redwood.company/sheets/dp-micro-v1-recruit (set owner column).

leo: I’ll mock the dashboard before EOD and attach `activation_rate` + `feedback_nps` columns.

nina: I'll start outreach tomorrow, will use two variants: short ask and detailed ask. Will report response rate by EOD Thu.

arjun: Telemetry + smoke script done, posting dashboard in thread when live.

emily: I can send NDA + stipend payment workflow to ops, should be cleared by Friday.

sasha: Great. Plan to onboard first partners next Wed. Check-in thread here on Thurs for early signals. If activation look low by day 3 we pause and iterate. :rocket:
